skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept, significance, and mission of business analysis.
Identify the objectives of business analysis.
Classify various business activities within an organization.
Differentiate between various methods of business analysis.
Apply appropriate analysis methods suitable for specific business activities.
Organize business analysis within an organization.
Demonstrate proficiency in communication and presentation skills.
Demonstrate proficiency in working independently and in teams.
Demonstrate self-management and responsibility for personal learning outcomes.
